title: Forever Wet
description: Permanently locks farmland moisture at maximum level (7). Soil will never dry out or revert to dirt, even without nearby water.
body:
# Forever Wet
​Forever Wet is a lightweight, server-side friendly NeoForge mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that completely removes the frustration of keeping your crops watered. No more tedious water channels breaking up your perfect fields—just hoe the dirt, plant your seeds and walk away.

## ​Features
- Automatic Hydration: When you make farmland, it will automatically turn into the hydrated farmland after some time
- ​Permanent Hydration: Once dirt is tilled into farmland, its moisture level is locked at maximum (moisture=7).
- ​Zero Dehydration: Farmland will never dry out, lose its dark texture, or revert back into regular dirt blocks, even in arid biomes or deep underground.
- 100% Vanilla Compatible: Players do not need the mod installed on their client to join a server running it. It works entirely on the server side (but functions perfectly in single-player, too!).

- Ultra Lightweight: Uses a highly optimized Mixin to intercept block ticks, meaning absolutely zero impact on game performance or MSPT.

## ​How It Works
​The mod injects a small piece of logic directly into Minecraft's FarmlandBlock behavior. It forces the game to always return true when checking if the block is near a water source, preventing the random tick decay from ever triggering.

## ​Support & Versions
​Current Version: NeoForge 1.21.1
​More versions and modloader ports are planned for the future!
